payload.title: Integrate receipt-sealed replay oracle into ClayCode BASE and H1 handoff
payload.work_clay: Use research_entity/trigger_runs/spawn/spawn-20260809T1918p0700-chatgpt-secondary-harness-rsd as the research input. Without advancing blocked H1 prematurely, implement the smallest production ClayCode/runtime receipt primitives needed by current BASE WP04/06/07/09/11/13 and a host-code oracle reusable by H1. Classify semantically relevant nondeterministic inputs (clock/random/model/peer/tool/visual/capability/scheduler/effect outcome), bind them into a receipt bundle, separate semantic transition identity from execution-trace identity, and implement external-effect recovery states including COMMIT_UNKNOWN when an adapter cannot prove outcome. Run omission-mutation, dual-hash, crash-window, real multithread/race and overhead tests on the Ubuntu developer target. Once BASE permits H1 execution, reuse the same receipt bundle for H1/H2 differential Golden Traces.
payload.reason_clay: Synthetic discrimination found 0/5000 divergence with complete receipt sealing but 4990-5000/5000 divergence when one semantic nondeterminism dimension was left live. 10000/10000 execution-metadata variants would falsely diverge under a full-trace semantic hash. A two-world crash counterexample shows local retry-or-skip cannot guarantee exactly-once for a non-idempotent, non-queryable external effect across the commit-before-outcome-receipt window.
payload.completion_clay: Production/Ubuntu receipts prove: (1) receipt omission mutations are detected; (2) same frozen receipt bundle plus initial semantic state reproduces identical authoritative post-state; (3) execution-only retry/latency metadata can differ without false semantic mismatch; (4) any execution field excluded from semantic identity is proven non-semantic for frozen fixtures; (5) external adapters are classified by dedupe/query/transaction semantics and ambiguous commit yields COMMIT_UNKNOWN rather than invented success/failure; (6) crash injection covers reserve/commit/outcome/re-entry boundaries; (7) deterministic replay tests and real multithread/race tests both run; (8) p50/p95/p99 overhead is recorded; (9) results feed BASE and later H1/H2 Golden Trace differential without granting a stage PASS from proxy evidence.
payload.executor_policy: Prefer the local repository/build organ with Ubuntu developer-host execution. Re-read newest main and live claims before writes; avoid H-WP-02 duplication; do not mark H1 complete while BASE is blocked; append receipts and use CAS-safe state updates. No paid training.
invalidators: Receipt model falsified by target-host counterexample
